research_question: Given the same uncertain initial anatomical estimate and approximately equal camera-motion expenditure, does incorporating the intended surgical trajectory improve downstream simulated navigation?

strategies.label: Fixed View
strategies.description: Camera remains at the common initial pose. A matched final observation is generated at that same pose using the common final seed.

strategies.label: Random Active
strategies.description: Uniform random selection from the exact same estimate-centred candidate set.

strategies.label: Generic Active
strategies.description: Uniform scene-wide predicted-information objective with the same movement coefficient as Full Task-Aware.

strategies.label: Movement-Budget-Matched Generic
strategies.description: Scene-wide Generic Active Perception with the development-frozen movement coefficient selected to approximately match Full Task-Aware camera movement.

strategies.label: Alignment-Only
strategies.description: Uniform scene information plus task-derived camera alignment. This isolates the alignment contribution.

strategies.label: Task-Weighted Information-Only
strategies.description: Task-weighted predicted scene information without the task-alignment reward.

strategies.label: Full Task-Aware
strategies.description: Task-weighted predicted information plus task-derived viewpoint alignment.

strategies.label: Privileged Oracle
strategies.description: Analysis-only privileged reference. Uses true anatomical and occluder geometry for scoring but must select from the same estimate-centred candidate set as every active strategy.

comparisons.name: primary_task_vs_budget_matched_generic
comparisons.interpretation: Tests whether task information improves simulated navigation when camera-motion expenditure is approximately matched.

comparisons.name: task_vs_same_weight_generic
comparisons.interpretation: Tests task-aware scoring against Generic using the identical movement coefficient.

comparisons.name: task_vs_fixed
comparisons.interpretation: Measures benefit relative to no active camera repositioning.

comparisons.name: task_vs_random
comparisons.interpretation: Measures benefit beyond arbitrary active camera repositioning.

comparisons.name: mechanism_alignment
comparisons.interpretation: Assesses whether task-weighted information adds benefit beyond alignment.

comparisons.name: mechanism_information
comparisons.interpretation: Assesses whether alignment adds benefit beyond task-weighted predicted information.

comparisons.name: task_vs_oracle
comparisons.interpretation: Estimates the remaining gap to a privileged true-geometry reference. Oracle is not deployable.

outcomes.name: safe_navigation_success_rate
outcomes.aggregation: success proportion within each held-out scenario across repetitions
outcomes.inferential_method: paired scenario-level sign-flip permutation test plus scenario-cluster bootstrap confidence interval
outcomes.description: Primary endpoint for downstream simulated navigation.

outcomes.name: planning_success_rate
outcomes.inferential_method: paired scenario-level sign-flip permutation test with secondary-family multiplicity control
outcomes.description: Whether uncertainty-aware motion planning finds a valid plan.

outcomes.name: mean_localisation_error_mm
outcomes.aggregation: mean within scenario, then paired across scenarios

outcomes.name: mean_predicted_sigma_mm
outcomes.aggregation: mean within scenario, then paired across scenarios

outcomes.name: camera_movement_mm
outcomes.aggregation: mean within scenario, then paired across scenarios
outcomes.inferential_method: descriptive paired difference and confidence interval
outcomes.description: Held-out movement-budget diagnostic. No weight may be retuned based on this result.

outcomes.name: paired_success_path_cost
outcomes.aggregation: evaluated only where both members of the paired comparison produced successful plans
outcomes.description: Conditional path-efficiency comparison without giving failed strategies an artificial path cost.

outcomes.name: collision_rate
outcomes.description: Simulation collision outcome. No clinical safety claim is permitted.

statistics.inferential_unit: held-out scenario; repetitions are nested within scenario and are not treated as independent experimental units
statistics.primary_test: two-sided paired scenario-level sign-flip permutation test on Full Task-Aware minus Movement-Budget-Matched Generic safe-navigation success rate
statistics.primary_confidence_interval: 95% scenario-cluster bootstrap interval for the paired mean scenario-level success-rate difference
statistics.primary_effect_measure: absolute safe-navigation success-rate difference: Full Task-Aware minus Movement-Budget-Matched Generic
statistics.superiority_rule: Claim statistical superiority only if the primary two-sided p-value is below 0.05 AND the 95% confidence interval for the Task-Aware minus matched-Generic effect lies entirely above zero.
statistics.secondary_multiplicity_rule: Any inferential p-values across secondary outcomes must use Holm correction within the secondary family. Descriptive diagnostics are not converted into post-hoc significance claims.
statistics.paired_success_rule: Path cost is compared only for scenario/repetition pairs where both compared strategies produced a successful plan.
statistics.held_out_budget_rule: Report held-out camera-movement mismatch exactly as observed. Do not retune either movement weight after held-out execution. If mismatch exceeds the previous 10% validation tolerance, retain all results but flag movement matching as a limitation.

tuning_rule: No strategy definition, weight, candidate-generation rule, random-seed rule, endpoint, statistical test or interpretation threshold may be changed in response to held-out results.
interpretation_rule: If the primary superiority criterion is not met, report that the held-out experiment did not establish superiority. Do not substitute a favourable secondary or subgroup result as the primary conclusion.
